caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile design composed of a grid pattern created by intersecting lines and shapes in shades of blue, black, and off-white or light gray. The central area consists of a tightly spaced checkerboard pattern with alternating small blue and white squares. Surrounding this central rectangle is a border made up of larger rectangles and squares, also in blue and white, but with more intricate internal line patterns and occasional black detailing. The corners of the border have larger squares with crosshatched designs, and the spaces between these corners are filled with repeating geometric motifs. The outer edges of the textile design have a more densely packed assortment of small rectangles and squares, continuing the woven appearance. The drawing is centered on a plain, light background, and at the bottom right, the name "LOV CRONK" is printed in small capital letters.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
